CAREERS
M1 Technology is looking for colleagues with mission or technology expertise to provide support to our clients. Many companies offer "competitive benefits." Our low overhead approach blows competitive benefits out of the water.
Here's a sampling of our benefits:
COMPENSATION
Our low overhead approach allows our staff to be well-compensated while still offering competitive rates for our clients.
401K
Our AMAZING 401k plan allows you to maximize your tax-free contribution, with flexibility to save for large purchases, like a home.
BONUS POOL
All M1 Technology staff are eligible for annual bonuses. We offer flexibility to take bonus payouts in cash or as additional PTO.
PAID TIME OFF
Our PTO policy allows staff to flex holiday and vacation hours within a given month and bank extra hours worked to provide a true work-life balance.
REFERRAL AND RETENTION PROGRAM
For each employee referred, M1 Technology employees receive a SIGNIFICANT, RECURRING referral bonus on the referral's yearly anniversary.
HEALTH REIMBURSEMENT ACCOUNT
We take healthcare VERY seriously. We cover employee out-of-pocket expenses with our one-of-a-kind Health Reimbursement Account.
TRAINING ALLOWANCE
All staff are reimbursed for expenses related to education, training, professional memberships, and conference attendance.
TECHNOLOGY STIPEND
All staff are reimbursed for technology related expenses like cell phones, computers, and tablets.
CELL PHONE REIMBURSEMENT
All staff are reimbursed for cell phone services.
INTERNET REIMBURSEMENT
All staff are reimbursed for home internet services.
REACH OUT
